William Faulkner, Soldiers’ Pay.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/william-faulkner/soldiers-pay

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- William Faulkner, the author, died 1962.

First publication of the text used: 1926 (SE colophon: 'Soldiers’ Pay was published in 1926 by William Faulkner.'; first published February 25, 1926, by Boni & Liveright, a United States publisher, per Wikipedia)

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in the United States in 1926, before 1931. Standard Ebooks states that the text is in the United States public domain (quoted below), and a work published in 1926 enters the United States public domain on 1 January 2022.
- Country of origin: the United States. The first publication was in the United States, before 1931, so the United States rule settles the country of origin whatever the death year. The author died in 1962, which would matter only for a country other than the United States, and this text does not need one.
